-- Phase 1 spec: deterministic pick from a non-empty list, no randomness.

-- Maps a seed onto a valid index in 0..n-1. `%` floors, so negative seeds are fine.
slot(n: int, seed: int) -> int =
  pre n > 0
  post 0 <= out and out < n
  ex slot(3, 7) == 1
  ex slot(3, -1) == 2
  seed % n

-- Same seed, same element. Depends only on xs and seed.
pick(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> int =
  pre xs.len() > 0
  ex pick([10, 20, 30], 7) == 20
  ex pick([5], 123) == 5
  xs[slot(xs.len(), seed)]
